title: Gold Saver Account: Adding authorized users to your account
summary: This document explains how to add, manage, and remove authorized users for a Gold Saver Account. It covers the limit of up to 5 authorized users, the steps to invite users (name/email, permissions, invitation acceptance), permission adjustments and dual review for sensitive actions, and procedures to suspend or remove users with activity audit during offboarding.
faqs: How many authorized users can I add to my Gold Saver Account?
What steps do I follow to add an authorized user (where do I go and what info is needed)?
How do I assign and adjust user permissions for roles and segregation of duties?
How does dual review work for sensitive actions?
What’s the difference between temporarily suspending a user and removing them from the account?
When I offboard a user, what should I audit?
